text:
Alana: quick heads-up — we need to slice the partner grant pool for the upcoming QBR. timeline tight: decisions by EOD Friday. current available pool: $450k. can we agree an allocation runway?

Mike S.: ok — propose splitting into three buckets: SI onboarding, co-marketing/joint announce, hw credits for pilot SIs. rough split idea: 45/35/20.

Sophia R.: that sounds reasonable. we should add a simple scoring rubric so PMs don't game for marketing-only asks. suggest weighting technical integration + joint-announce readiness higher.

Jess - Finance: FYI we can free up $150k from the revamp line, plus $300k from runway if we push merch spend. so $450k is doable but need cost-center tag PART-GRANT-Q3 and PO by Fri noon. legal approvals if >$75k per partner.

Alana: thanks Jess — noted legal gate. Sophia: can you draft the quick rubric? keep it PR-friendly and fast to evaluate.

Sophia R.: sending a lightweight draft now — happy to iterate.

Sophia R.: ```
weights:
  go_to_market: 35
  technical_readiness: 30
  revenue_pipeline: 20
  strategic_fit: 15
```

Mike S.: minor tweak: swap revenue_pipeline & strategic_fit to favor early GTM partners. new weights: 40/30/20/10. also recommend a hard cap per partner: $100k max, $25k min.

Jess - Finance: caps are fine. note: any >$50k requires exec signoff (Legal + GTM lead). update PO template with cap fields.

Alana: can we run the current candidate list through this rubric this afternoon? I can own coordination. Who can help score?

Mike S.: I can score the SI and hw candidates.

Sophia R.: I’ll take joint-announce and integration maturity.

funds-bot: budget-claim created: PART-GRANT-Q3 / 3301112222 / reserved $450000. :robot_face:

Jess - Finance: I'll prepare the PO template and email approvals flow. tagging @legal for signoff checklist.

Alana: awesome. target: rubric scores back by 5pm today, PO draft by tomorrow AM. thanks everyone :thumbsup:
